static_findings.claim: The final executable main passes argv past the executable name and branches to the exported compiled C entry.

The native clbg entry contains direct calls to fresh runtime-state initialization and then the original driver. This establishes the compiled path once this body is selected, not the actual runtime selection of it.
State construction contains fresh GC allocations, copies the planetary constants, updates the bodies binding and computes the momentum adjustment.
The original driver directly calls energy before the loop, parses the runtime argument, passes that integer to nbody, then directly calls energy again and formats both results.

The native integration body checks the argument, derives x13 from the supplied iteration count, performs floating-point body updates and stores, then decrements x13 and takes its nonzero backedge. The timestep constant is the native encoding of 0.01.

unresolved_entry.details: The exported entry loads jl_ext_4 fptr and last_world, compares against jl_world_counter, may call jl_get_abi_converter, then executes an indirect branch. jl_ext_4 includes native julia_clbg_entry_5209 and the compiled generic thunk j_5337_gfthunk, which boxes arguments and calls ijl_apply_generic. Static presence of the direct native path does not prove which target was returned or called in a process.

runtime_source_context.interpretation: The tagged implementation can reuse a still-valid CodeInstance/native target or select its unspecialized thunk when code generation cannot provide an adapter. This source explanation is not a runtime observation of this executable.

serialized_image_gap: No actual inspection yet establishes the relevant Method.source, CodeInstance.inferred, invoke/specptr fields or opaque-closure bodies after loading this serialized image. trim/strip_ir options and absence of libjulia-codegen are insufficient by themselves.

next_diagnostic.reason: Reuse the exact retained bounded output oracle while collecting dispatch evidence; no full-size benchmark or measurement repeat.
next_diagnostic.mode: A supervisor-owned LLDB target launch of this executable; no attach to an unrelated process. No replacement executable or runtime code patch on disk.
next_diagnostic.environment_policy: Use the retained no-codegen diagnostic environment, with JULIA_LOAD_CODEGEN_LIB=0. Save actual debugger and target environments separately; preserve normal stdout/stderr in separate files.
observations: Validate exact loaded-image identities and slides; bind the real main image and matching libjulia-internal bytes to retained symbol offsets before setting or interpreting breakpoints.

Observe the exported-entry world-age branch and actual x8 immediately before its indirect call at image-relative0x45c4; require the observed target to equal image-relative0x1afcc for native entry selection.
Record hits at native entry, fresh-state constructor, original driver, energy and nbody; read the argument at nbody entry. Preserve the complete event order and all unexpected stops.

Place breakpoints by loaded address at all four retained local interpreter entry points and at relevant public/codegen/fallback routes. Save per-breakpoint resolved locations and hit counts; unresolved or zero-location breakpoints invalidate absence claims.

At the entry/ABI boundary use debugger memory inspection, without target expression evaluation, to retain the actual cfuncdata and selected CodeInstance/invoke/specptr/inferred fields. Derive layouts from exact matching runtime headers and debug types, and reject unavailable or inconsistent types.

local_interpreter_symbols.address_note: These are file symbol values. Resolve the actual loaded slide and executable section; do not treat them as process addresses.

preconditions: Freeze the exact debugger/tool and Python scripting API path, target ownership/cleanup behavior, command timeout and log limits before launch.

Calibrate breakpoint resolution and a known captured stop; a negative missing-native or deliberately verifier-rejected dispatch case remains a separate explicit fallback-verifier test, never an inference from zero hits.
next_diagnostic.acceptance_limit: One bounded trace can establish the actual entry path and any observed fallback for that run. It cannot alone prove every serialized method is stripped or that every possible input/error path excludes interpretation.
